intro.heroText: A land where history, culture, and breathtaking nature merge into one unforgettable journey.

section1.title: Lebanon: A Country of Timeless Beauty
section1.text: Lebanon rests along the Mediterranean Sea, offering a unique blend of ancient heritage and modern lifestyle. Known for its resilience, warmth, and hospitality.

section2.title: Legacy
section2.text1: Home to the Phoenicians—masters of trade and navigation—Lebanon helped shape the first alphabet.
section2.text2: Cities like Byblos, Baalbek, Sidon, and Tyre preserve remarkable archaeological treasures.

section3.title: Cultural Diversity
section3.text: Lebanon is home to multiple religious and cultural communities living side by side, creating a vibrant cultural mosaic.

section4.title: Nature Like Nowhere Else
section4.text: Ski in the morning, swim in the afternoon. Beaches, mountains, forests, and waterfalls — all in one country.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How can I create a smart itinerary?
faq.a1: Go to the Smart Itinerary page, enter your trip details, and the system will generate a plan for you.
faq.q2: Can I use the platform without logging in?
faq.a2: Yes, you can explore some features as a guest, but some features require login.
faq.a3: You can fill out the contact form on this page and send your message.
faq.q4: Can I save my favorite places?
faq.a4: Yes, logged-in users can save places to their favorites.
faq.q5: Does the platform support multiple languages?
faq.a5: Yes, the platform supports English, Arabic, and French.
faq.a6: Yes, you can report any issue using the support form.
faq.q7: How does the AI assistant help me?
faq.a7: The AI assistant helps you discover places, plan trips, and get tourism suggestions in Lebanon.
faq.a8: Yes, recommendations can be based on your preferences, interests, and selected activities.
